title: Red Sox trade deadline live updates: Will Craig Breslow make another big move?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquired Curtis Mead from Nationals, but Mead's injury has left team still seeking additional offensive power.
Rivals like Yankees and Rays are bolstering their rosters, adding urgency for Boston to make significant trades.
Marlins' Otto Lopez off market, but catcher Liam Hicks is a potential trade target for the Red Sox.

title: Man killed in East Boston overnight shooting
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A man was shot and killed near 464 Meridian St. in East Boston early Sunday morning, police responded at 1:30 a.m.
The victim was taken to a local hospital and pronounced dead; his identity will be released after next of kin are notified.
The Boston Police Department's Homicide Unit is investigating, and no arrests have been made; information can be reported to 617-343-4470.

title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a shooting on Hancock St., Dorchester, late Friday night, police report.
Both victims suffered non-life-threatening injuries; one was hospitalized, while the other went to the hospital independently.
No arrests have been made as of Sunday morning; police are continuing their investigation into the incident.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman injured after clothing trapped in MBTA Davis escalator on Friday; incident similar to previous fatality.
Fellow rider used emergency stop to aid woman; MBTA and Somerville Fire Department responded to the scene.
MBTA warns riders to use handrails and be cautious of loose clothing on escalators following recent incidents.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men, Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio, were arrested after a knifepoint robbery in Dorchester.
The victim reported being robbed of a chain and wallet by two men on a moped near 140 Humboldt Ave.
Aguasvivas was arraigned and held without bail; Ramirez-Astacio was found with an outstanding warrant for multiple charges.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends participatory budgeting proposal deadline to August 7, allowing residents to suggest projects for $2 million funding.
Projects must be one-time investments within Boston's authority, submitted through participate.boston.gov or by calling 617-635-3059.
Final proposals will be voted on by residents in a citywide voting period from January 15 to February 15.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs in his first two at-bats against the Dodgers on Saturday.
Rafaela's homers came off Dodgers' pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto, tying the game with a 402-foot shot in the third inning.
Rafaela added to his 11 season home runs, reaching 14 by the third inning of the second game in the series.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Red Sox made a substantial offer for Reds' shortstop Elly De La Cruz, which was declined by Cincinnati.
Boston's offer for De La Cruz primarily included prospects, but the two teams didn't agree on the deal's terms.
Red Sox acquired Curtis Mead for infield support but pursue more options due to his wrist injury.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye reports his shoulder 'feels great' during Patriots training camp after Super Bowl injury.
Drake Maye highlights improvement in Patriots offense with addition of wide receiver A.J. Brown.
New England Patriots gear up for Week 1 Super Bowl rematch against Seattle Seahawks.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4, showcasing their potential for a postseason run.
Ceddanne Rafaela turned a 4-3 deficit into a 5-4 victory with key offensive plays.
Boston excels despite missing key players, positioning themselves as buyers before the trade deadline.
